papier wallpaper: An eCommerce Project by Xylo Solutions

Luxury wallpaper store redesigned to improve product discovery, strengthen conversions, and elevate premium brand presentation.

Project showcase

Papier wallpaper is a premium home decor and wallpaper brand focused on statement interiors, refined textures, and timeless design aesthetics. Xylo Solutions partnered with the brand to create an elevated eCommerce experience designed to improve conversions, strengthen customer trust, and showcase collections with greater impact. As a trusted shopify website design company, our objective was to transform the storefront into a premium destination that reflects the sophistication of the products while supporting long term growth.

The project included a full website redesign with cleaner collection structures, improved visual hierarchy, and a smoother browsing journey across wallpapers, patterns, and featured interior collections. Product pages were strategically refined to present texture, scale, and design inspiration more effectively while helping customers shop with confidence. As an experienced shopify web design company, we also optimized mobile usability and navigation flow to improve engagement across every device.

To support sustainable growth, the site architecture was enhanced for stronger product discovery and a more seamless purchase journey. This level of execution reflects the quality expected from a modern shopify website design agency focused on premium lifestyle brands. The final result is a polished and scalable storefront built through strategic shopify web design services and tailored shopify design services that help papier wallpaper grow with authority.
